description.en: The name of the packaging group.

description.zh: 搜索关键词，列举查询点播打包资产名称以该关键词为前缀的打包资产列表。
description.en: The search keyword. The names of the returned assets are prefixed with this keyword.

description.zh: 分页查询每页大小，默认10。
description.en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10.

description.zh:
列表排序规则，默认 desc，可选：
- desc： 按创建时间倒序排列；
- asc：按创建时间正序排列。
description.en:
The sorting order of the assets based on the time when they were ingested. Valid values:

- desc (default): descending order.

- asc: ascending order.
